g.text: Durable execution in the worker · server-scoped tools · exact-revision customer confirmation
API returns busy=true; SSE reads saved state
Up to 3 interrupted claims; explicit customer retry
02 AGENT HARNESS / worker process · agent.py + agent_provider.py + agent_tools.py
Identity cannot come from model args
Stable preparation key from turn ID
04 PURCHASING CHECKS / deterministic application code, never model authority
05 CUSTOMER CONFIRMATION / separate authenticated API path
BOUNDARY The model proposes. Application code validates. The customer confirms. Accepted orders remain mocks.
Evidence: agent*.py · worker.py · conversations.py · service.py · approval_policy.py · approval_workflow.py · migrations
